description: Glands and other organs: heparin and its salts: other human or animal substances prepared for therapeutic or prophylactic uses, n.e.c. in heading 3001
Medicaments: containing vitamins or their derivatives, for therapeutic or prophylactic use, packaged for retail sale

Juice: of single citrus fruit (excluding orange or grapefruit), of a Brix value not exceeding 20, unfermented, not containing added spirit, whether or not containing added sugar or other sweetening matter
Undenatured ethyl alcohol: of an alcoholic strength by volume of 80% vol. or higher
Stones: of heading no. 2515 or 2516 (excluding marble), in granules, chippings and powder, whether or not heat-treated
Machines incorporating a calculating device: n.e.c. in heading no. 8470
Poultry: live, fowls of the species Gallus domesticus, weighing not more than 185g
Birds: live, other than birds of prey, Psittaciformes, ostriches and emus (Dromaius novaehollandiae)
Vegetables: mushrooms of the genus Agaricus, fresh or chilled
Fruit, edible: oranges, fresh or dried
Cereal groats and meal: of maize (corn)
Vegetable oils: soya-bean oil and its fractions, other than crude, whether or not refined, but not chemically modified
Margarine: excluding liquid margarine
Alcohols: cyclanic, cyclenic or cycloterpenic and derivatives, menthol
Medicaments: containing insulin, for therapeutic or prophylactic uses, packaged for retail sale
Dressings, adhesive: and other articles having an adhesive layer, packed for retail sale for medical, surgical, dental or veterinary purposes
Colouring matter: pigments and preparations based on chromium compounds
Paints and varnishes: (including enamels, lacquers and distempers), prepared water pigments of a kind used for finishing leather
Perfumes and toilet waters
Anti-knock preparations: other than those based on lead compounds
Plastics: articles of apparel and clothing accessories (including gloves, mittens and mitts)
Rubber: unvulcanised, (compounded other than with carbon black or silica), in primary forms, (other than plates, sheets, strip, solutions or dispersions)

Cement, concrete or artificial stone: prefabricated structural components for building or civil engineering, whether or not reinforced
Cellulose fibre-cement: articles or the like, other than corrugated sheets and other sheets, panels, tiles and similar articles, not containing asbestos
